name: KittyKind
neighborhoods: Manhattan adoption center (Petco Union Square); accepts adoptable cats citywide from TNR rescuers
notes:
All-volunteer no-kill 501(c)(3) (est. 1999), 400+ cats/yr. Manhattan-based adoption hub - NOT Brooklyn field response - but a key PLACEMENT partner that takes in adoptable friendlies from rescuers' TNR efforts, incl. special-needs/senior cats. Useful downstream when a Brooklyn rescuer needs an adoption channel. Emails confirmed on own site. Verified 2026-08-26.
